inbox.title: Jess's birthday party
inbox.body: Dance all night. Best night in months. Your legs disagree.

inbox.title: T18 at the Dry Creek City Amateur
Lights on at the putting green
inbox.body: Grind putts till midnight. 100 four-footers in a row. You can see the line in your sleep.

inbox.title: Welcome to the road
inbox.body: You're 18, you've got a hand-me-down driver and a dream. Play the Amateur Circuit, train hard, and turn pro when you're ready. Q-School is the door to the LPGA.
